title: E-Commerce Platform Modernization
summary: Complete rebuild of a legacy e-commerce platform serving 2M+ monthly users.
challenge: The client's monolithic platform was struggling with performance, scaling issues, and long deployment cycles. Frequent outages during peak traffic were costing significant revenue.
solution: We architected a microservices-based platform using React, Node.js, and AWS. Implemented event-driven architecture with automated CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment time from hours to minutes.
outcome: 99.9% uptime achieved, page load times reduced by 60%, and the platform now handles 5x peak traffic without degradation. Revenue increased 35% due to improved user experience.

title: AI-Powered Document Processing
summary: Intelligent document analysis system using NLP and computer vision.
challenge: Manual document review was taking legal teams hundreds of hours. The client needed an automated solution to extract, classify, and analyze information from thousands of documents daily.
solution: Developed a custom ML pipeline combining OCR, NLP transformers, and document classification models. Built a React dashboard for human-in-the-loop validation.
outcome: Document processing time reduced by 85%, accuracy reached 97%, and the system processes 10,000+ documents daily with minimal human intervention.

title: Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Migration
summary: Strategic migration of 200+ workloads from on-premise to hybrid multi-cloud.
challenge: The client operated legacy on-premise infrastructure across 5 data centers, facing high maintenance costs, limited scalability, and compliance challenges.
solution: Designed a hybrid multi-cloud strategy spanning AWS and Azure. Implemented Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, containerized applications with Kubernetes, and established comprehensive monitoring and disaster recovery.
outcome: Infrastructure costs reduced by 40%, deployment frequency increased 10x, and the environment achieved SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance.
